temporal_notes: Baseline resistance status and target site mutation testing carried out in October 2015 prior to spraying; experimental hut study conducted October 2015 to May 2016.
source_text: The study was conducted in the experimental station at Covè, Southern Benin, over a period of 8 months (October 2015 to May 2016). The huts were built alongside a paddy field which constitutes the permanent breeding sites for Anopheles mosquitoes.
